thread:
morgan: Heads-up — during the 11:02-11:05 spike autopage did not create a PagerDuty incident for svc-auth. Incident-bot posted a summary to #incidents but nobody was paged.

devon: ah, saw a couple manual pings but no automated page? Can you paste the bot post and any errors?

morgan: copied the bot post below and grabbed ops-bot log snippet.

ops-bot: [11:03:12] incident-bot POST /webhook -> 200 OK (payload accepted)
ops-bot: [11:03:13] routing: lookup channel id for 'svc-auth-prod' -> NOT FOUND (alias lookup returned empty)
ops-bot: [11:03:14] decision: store as orphaned-alert in queue:sync, no pager call

sre-ian: hmm, mapping failure. We rolled channel renames last week — did the alias table get rebuilt?

devon: checking mapping DB now... running query: `SELECT * FROM channel_aliases WHERE alias = 'svc-auth-prod'`
devon: result: empty. But canonical id exists as `C85Q1X3` (old name was `svc-auth`). Looks like alias import missed the trailing `-prod` variants.

morgan: we manually paged PD at 11:08 and oncall acknowledged. manual mitigation: scale-up + restart auth workers. Impact window ~11:02-11:12.

alice: oncall-nyc confirmed manual page at 11:08 and started the restart, acked at 11:09.

oncall-nyc: acked, performed restart, errors dropped to baseline by 11:11.

sunita: customer impact — any 504/5xx counts? I need numbers for the incident label.

morgan: metrics: ~1.2k 5xxs across 3 min, about 0.6% of total requests. A handful of enterprise tenants saw retries fail (we've contacted account SRE).

devon: root cause hypothesis: channel alias import/regen didn't include `-prod` suffixes after the recent channel standardization. incident-bot resolves channel via alias table; missing alias -> no pager mapping.

sre-ian: immediate mitigation: 1) add quick fallback in routing: if alias lookup fails, try simple suffix heuristics (`alias + "-prod"`, `alias - "-canary"`) and fallback to canonical ID. 2) enqueue a batch job to rebuild aliases from workspace metadata. 3) add an observability metric: `incidentbot.routing.misses` and an alert if rate > 1/min.

devon: pushed a hotfix branch: `incbot/alias-fallback` with suffix heuristics, will deploy to staging now.

morgan: deployed hotfix to prod at 11:30, running synthetic test: `curl -X POST https://inc-bot/webhook -d '{"channel":"svc-auth-prod","alert":"test"}'` -> now triggers PD.

ops-bot: [11:31:02] incident-bot POST -> 200 OK; routing resolved to C85Q1X3; pager call issued -> OK

sunita: good. For the postmortem: timeline, missed pages, customer impact, mitigation steps, and a follow-up to fix alias import process. Also recommend runbook change: if routing misses x3 in 10m, escalate to oncall via alternate channel.

oncall-nyc: +1 on runbook change. Manual fallback was noisy and slow today.

alice: I'll file the follow-up tickets: (1) alias-import bug (#INC-4921), (2) add `incidentbot.routing.misses` alert (#INC-4922), (3) runbook update and training session (#INC-4923).

morgan: assigning owners: devon -> alias-import bug, sre-ian -> metrics/alert, alice -> runbook + postmortem draft.

devon: timeline note for postmortem: 11:02 spike starts, 11:03 incident-bot accepted payload but missed mapping, 11:08 manual PD page, 11:09 oncall ack + restart, 11:11 errors down, 11:30 hotfix deployed, 11:31 verification OK.

sre-ian: thanks — I'll collect logs (inc-bot, alias service, webhook relay) and drop into the postmortem doc. Quick grep commands I'll use: `journalctl -u incident-bot | grep "routing: lookup"` and `psql -c "SELECT alias, canonical_id FROM channel_aliases WHERE alias LIKE '%svc-auth%';"`

alice: tagging this as P1-missed-paging for tracking. Will start postmortem doc and ping later for review. :spiral_note_pad:

morgan: thanks everyone. If anyone sees other orphaned-alerts in the queue, please escalate here and we'll reprocess after alias rebuild.

ops-bot: [automated] orphaned-alert-queue size: 3 -> scheduling reprocess job at 11:45.
